translation: <ins>Qingshang Yuxue Tang</ins> (Clearing the Upper and Dispersing Blood Decoction, 清上瘀血湯) treats those injured above the diaphragm. Qianghuo (Notopterygium), Duhuo (Angelica pubescens), Lianqiao (Forsythia), Jiegeng (Platycodon), Zhiqiao (bitter orange), Chishao (red peony), Danggui (Angelica, washed in wine), Shanzhizi (Gardenia), Huangqin (Scutellaria), Gancao (licorice), Chuanxiong (Ligusticum), Taoren (peach kernel), Honghua (safflower), Sumu (sappan wood), Chuan Dahuang (rhubarb), Shengdihuang (raw Rehmannia). Decoct in water, add old wine and boy's urine, and take together. <ins>Xiaoxia Poxue Tang</ins> (Dispersing the Lower and Breaking Blood Decoction, 消下破血湯) treats those injured below the diaphragm.
